mechanism: Indomethacin may increase haloperidol levels via CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while both drugs carry independent risks of extrapyramidal effects and reduced GI protection.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, tardive dyskinesia); consider alternative NSAID or dose adjustment; use gastroprotection given NSAID-haloperidol GI ulcer risk.
